purpose: Keep round-6 raw worker labels separate from the reconciled dispositions for all 15 residual freshness rows, so that no reader mistakes a raw 'supported' verdict for a reconciled whole-claim verdict. Raw labels are copied verbatim from the round-6 source ledgers; reconciled dispositions are copied from reports/round-8/targets.json (the round-6 reconciliation) and, for R8-F15 only, re-adjudicated by this shard in round 8.

legend.raw_label: verbatim round-6 worker verdict field from corpus/lessons/round-6-sources/<NN>.json (never rewritten here)
legend.raw_support_scope: verbatim round-6 worker support_scope field from the same ledger
legend.reconciled_disposition: reconciled disposition carried in reports/round-8/targets.json prior_disposition (round-6 reconciliation), except R8-F15 where this shard re-adjudicated in round 8
legend.reconciliation_basis: short basis copied from the same targets.json row
legend.round8_receipt: path of the round-8 recheck receipt for the residual (written by that residual's own shard)
legend.round8_receipt_present_at_generation: file existence checked at presence_checked_at; siblings may land later, so absence here is a timestamped observation, not a claim about their content

rows.reconciliation_basis: The encyclopedia reports learned/cultic survival after vernacular decline, but the requested dated text or directly inspected scholarly passage was not retrieved.
The FIT mediator supports keeping texture, construction proposal and Greek-derived naming separate. The entry does not actually use 'kaunakes'.
The tertiary sanctuary description locates horned hats on the male-deity procession and distinguishes a god/king caption.
The main Melqart etymology is a tertiary relay of Lipinski; the related Persée bilingualism passage and Louvre dedication do not themselves verify that etymology.
Rutter's main passage directly supports Linear A's undeciphered status; readable-Greek Linear B evidence sits in separately retrieved corroborations.
UT Lesson 2 directly supports cult provenance, copy layers and Akkadogram versus Hittite reading, but not all language-genealogy legs.
DB99's translated selection supports elite archive selectivity, dated charges, named diviners, ancestors and Di; companion childbearing content is a separate URL.
The transmitted Zhouli transcription contains the cited bi/Heaven and cong/Earth formula and prescriptive institutional language.
Sotah 7:6 witnesses the written-name/Temple/substitute distinction; other qere and reception legs depend on a different reference-work URL or remain unquoted.
Exodus 28 carries the priestly garment prescription and named addressees, but the four/eight Yoma classification has its own different corroboration URL.
The retrieved paper establishes an administrative Old Persian isolate and explicitly limits generalization; parent confirms the quotation on page 9, correcting the worker's 5-8 locator range.
Boyce's pinned archived prose supports competing winged-symbol identifications and later Zoroastrian reception.
The main genetics paper describes a non-IE language not fully understood; alphabet adaptation is Mnamon corroboration and the Tyrsenian leg is tertiary.
Rilly's paper names the proposed NES grouping and distinguishes deciphered script from limited understanding; the Old Nubian leg uses a different publisher excerpt.
Strabo's translated foreign report supplies a ruling Candace, commanders, son and embassies with an attributed gendered description.

round8_recheck.delta_vs_round6: Strabo leg re-verified with fresh hash/line-located retrieval; title-translation leg upgraded from tertiary-only to a peer-reviewed passage (Rowan 2009, PDF p. 7: kdke is phonemically /kandake/, coda nasal unwritten); raw fugitive/fugitives doubt settled at the cited-witness level; Hofmann 1981 p. 41, Torok 1997 pp. 213-214, the Greek original and the Lohwasser PDF remain unread with documented failures.

counts.counting_command: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('reports/round-8/freshness/reconciliation.json'));r=d['rows'];print('rows',len(r));print('raw_supported',sum(1 for x in r if x['raw_label']=='supported'));print('reconciled',{k:sum(1 for x in r if x['reconciled_disposition']==k) for k in ('unresolved','partial-support')});print('present',sum(1 for x in r if x['round8_receipt_present_at_generation']))"
